integrity: Proof combines addition theorem, equiangular-line tight-frame identity, Legendre recurrence and classical Bernstein estimate. The finite computational checks are supplementary and are not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only exact degree on twelve regular icosahedron vertices; rank-six output interpolation does not identify high-dimensional inputs; priority risk from older inaccessible icosahedral representation literature.
title: All-degree spectral and rank classification for icosahedral spherical-harmonic sampling
